info.title: 清源 ClearTrace API
info.description: Shared data/model integration contract. Application bearer tokens and Sites gateway access are separate. Browser calls use Sites sign-in plus application membership. Responses use {data}, except CSV export and this raw OpenAPI document. Synthetic examples and rule baseline are not trained-model evaluation results. InferenceRequest/InferenceResponse describe the external server protocol, not an endpoint hosted by ClearTrace. 模型接入轮次新增协同线索、事件图谱、评论筛查与能力状态接口;WB01 分数与协同线索排序分是两种不同能力,不能合并成一个概率。 本轮补充:WB01 原始契约接口、新事件协同在线扫描、逐表/整库导出。

Admin/editor only. Dry run defaults to true and returns 200 with valid=false for row-level errors. A valid commit returns 201; an invalid commit returns 400 without importing. Duplicate accountId values in the batch are deduplicated. Maximum full body 5 MiB and 1000 records. Same-name imports create subsequent dataset versions.
